verdict.rationale: Datadog publishes a first-party API Reference at docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest/, with an AI-agent-friendly markdown version, so the product can be driven through a documented public API. The OpenAPI probe 404s only show that no spec exists at the guessed paths; they do not contradict the API's existence. Missing for 10: evidence of endpoint breadth, auth details, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec at a discoverable location, and independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: For AI agents: A markdown version of this page is available at https://docs.datadoghq.com/api/latest.md
